title: 瑞典大选反转：社民党称领先，右翼反超三席
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: To me, the result isn't that surprising. I was quite confident that it was far more narrow compared to what different polls suggested, so I'm not that surprised. Now it's extremely
segments.zh: 对我来说，这个结果并不意外。我原本就确信差距会比民调显示的小得多，所以并不惊讶。现在局势极其

segments.en: narrow. Perhaps so narrow as we cannot simply say yet, who has won and who has lost.
segments.zh: 胶着。可能胶着到我们无法简单断言谁赢谁输。

segments.en: And that's the reason why I say tonight that now we have to wait for the final results.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么我今晚说，现在必须等待最终结果。

segments.en: Now we must wait for the final election result. Every vote that has been cast must be counted,
segments.zh: 现在我们必须等待最终选举结果。每一张已投的选票都必须被清点，

segments.en: but my message is clear. We social democrats will always stand ready to take responsibility for the outcome. But right now we are leading. If this holds, Sweden will have a new government.
segments.zh: 但我的信息很明确。我们社民党始终准备为结果承担责任。但眼下我们领先。如果这一优势保持，瑞典将迎来新政府。

segments.en: The prime minister and the opposition leader in Sweden there. Let's bring in our Chief Europe correspondent Oliver Crook for more on this story. Good morning.
segments.zh: 以上是瑞典首相和反对党领袖。让我们连线首席欧洲记者奥利弗·克鲁克了解更多。早上好。

segments.en: Good morning. This morning, talk us through what we know about the results in Sweden so far.
segments.zh: 早上好。今天早上，请给我们讲讲目前瑞典选举结果的情况。

segments.en: And when we might actually get a final result. Yeah, that's a big question, Steven. Over the last sort of hour or so crossing the wire.
segments.zh: 以及我们何时能真正得到最终结果。是的，这是个关键问题，史蒂文。过去一小时左右消息陆续传来。

segments.en: We've got about 94% of the vote counted as you just heard there from the opposition leader Magdalena Anderson, who is now potentially going to step into government if they manage to maintain that lead.
segments.zh: 正如你刚才听到反对党领袖玛格达莱娜·安德森所说，约94%的选票已清点，如果她能保持领先，可能将步入政府。

segments.en: That is only a three seat lead. That being said, there are still a number of votes still coming in.
segments.zh: 这仅领先三个席位。话虽如此，仍有不少选票还在统计中。

segments.en: There are people who voted early, for example, they mailed their ballots and there are people voting from abroad.
segments.zh: 有些人提前投票，比如邮寄选票，还有海外选民。

segments.en: They're also going to have to count every single one of these votes.
segments.zh: 这些选票每一张都必须清点。
